name: blueprint/dependency-audit
description: Dependency vulnerabilities as receipts: run the audit, receipt exit + tail, notify once on high severity, re-audit after the fix
recipe: run the audit (exit code is the verdict) -> receipt the result -> high severity: notify once -> fix, re-audit, receipt again
pitfalls: audit exit codes are the verdict - warnings that exit 0 are green
the fix loop reruns only the audit
